install.documented: export UV_TORCH_BACKEND=cu130; uv pip install --no-build-isolation axolotl[deepspeed]
install.ours: uv project depending on axolotl==0.21.1 and parity (editable, so the reference runs in this environment); every transitive version constrained to the 2026-11-23 WSL spike's resolution of `uv pip install axolotl==0.21.1` (docs/evidence/2026-11-23-m1-wsl-spike/freeze/axolotl.txt); pytest added for the adapter tests

deviations: No [deepspeed] extra: DeepSpeed is for distributed training and is not on the data path; the spike's resolution did not include it.
UV_TORCH_BACKEND not set: torch resolved from PyPI's default Linux wheel (2.14.1+cu130), as in the spike.
No GPU: Axolotl's docs require an NVIDIA or AMD GPU. The data path (dataset preparation and collator) runs on CPU; training is never run.
Not installed with --no-build-isolation: the spike's plain install needed no build step.
runtime_settings: AXOLOTL_DO_NOT_TRACK=1 and DO_NOT_TRACK=1 (Axolotl's telemetry is opt-out; set by the adapter before importing Axolotl).
dataset_num_proc: 1, bf16/fp16 off, val_set_size: 0, shuffle_merged_datasets: false: don't touch tokenization or labels.
axolotl preprocess flag --debug-num-examples 0: the default debug sample crashes on a one-row dataset (random.randrange(0, len(dataset) - 1) in axolotl/common/datasets.py).
